title: LoX: Low-Rank Extrapolation Robustifies LLM Safety Against Fine-tuning

summary.claim: Fine-tuning breaks safety alignment, even on benign-looking data, because safety-critical low-rank subspaces are sensitive. LoX extrapolates this subspace further along its direction and cuts attack success by 11–54 points.
summary.condition: Training-free, applied to the weights of an aligned model; evaluated under benign and malicious fine-tuning attacks.
summary.gap: (Inferred) The abstract names no models or datasets, and whether the effect holds for large-scale fine-tuning is unknown.
